An '''electromagnetic sensor''',<ref name="RASB" /> also known as an '''electromagnetic detector''', '''electromagnetic receptor''', and '''Electromagnetic Field Sensor Unit''',<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. They were fitted on a variety of [[Droid/Legends|droids]], such as the [[M38-series explorer droid]],<ref name="RASB" /> the [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]],<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] such as the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2]] and [[R5-series astromech droid|R5-series]] models, and the [[Hound-W2 SPD]].<ref name="EGTD" />
